description: Send a booking (kind 'book', slot 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM', with service_id, or party_size for tables), order (kind 'order': details with what the customer wants in their words, and/or items [{offer_id, qty}]; fulfilment pickup|delivery) or quote request (kind 'quote', details) for the customer. The business confirms it. Ask the customer before sending. Include customer_email so Loomivo emails the customer when the business confirms or declines.
name: create_request
title: Send a booking, order or quote request
